provisions.title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
provisions.description: When a contract is broken, the party who suffers from the breach is entitled to compensation for loss or damage caused naturally in the usual course of things, or which the parties knew would likely result. Compensation is not given for remote or indirect loss.

provisions.title: Compensation for breach where a penalty is stipulated
provisions.description: Where a contract names a sum payable on breach, or provides a penalty, the court may award reasonable compensation not exceeding that amount. A stipulation that is a penalty is not enforced as such; only reasonable compensation is awarded.

provisions.title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee
provisions.description: Sets out the rights and liabilities of the lessor (landlord) and lessee (tenant), including the lessee's obligations as to the condition of the property, the lessor's duty to disclose material defects, and the position on return of possession at the end of the lease.

provisions.title: Definition of 'deficiency'
provisions.description: Defines a deficiency as any shortcoming, inadequacy or imperfection in the quality, nature or manner of performance of a service that is required to be maintained by law or undertaken to be performed under a contract.

provisions.title: Manner in which a complaint may be made
provisions.description: Describes how a consumer may file a complaint before the District Commission, including by a recognised consumer association or legal heir, and the accompanying documents and fee.

provisions.title: Settlement of disputes outside the Court
provisions.description: Where it appears to the court that an element of settlement exists, the court may refer the dispute to arbitration, conciliation, judicial settlement including through Lok Adalat, or mediation.

provisions.title: Settlement in arbitration
provisions.description: Allows the arbitral tribunal to encourage settlement and, with the parties' agreement, to settle the dispute on agreed terms, recorded as an award on agreed terms.

provisions.title: Cases in which specific performance of contract is enforceable
provisions.description: States that specific performance of a contract is enforced by the court when there is no adequate remedy (for example, damages) available for its breach.

provisions.title: Organisation of Lok Adalats
provisions.description: Provides for the organisation of Lok Adalats by Legal Services Authorities to settle disputes amicably through conciliation and mediation.
